# QIT M365 Best: technician runbook

*Generated by generate_reports.py from report_levels.json and CIPP's standards.json. Don't edit this file by hand.*

**Microsoft license:** Microsoft Entra ID P2 or Microsoft 365 E5

Best is governed identity and data: risk-based sign-in and user policies, phishing-resistant authentication for all staff, an idle session timeout for sensitive clients, and Customer Lockbox. Privileged Identity Management, access reviews, sensitivity labels and DLP are set up in Entra and Purview. CIPP has no test for them, so they are not in this report.

Reaching Best needs Microsoft Entra ID P2, or Microsoft 365 E5, for the people it covers, and a project to deploy risk policies and just-in-time administrator access.

**Checks:** 13. **Dashboard suite:** QIT M365 Best.

## How to use this runbook

Results appear on the CIPP Dashboard: select the tenant, then the suite named above. Refresh Test Data re-runs every CIPP test for the tenant. A full refresh can take from a few minutes to a couple of hours.

Each check shows one of these statuses:

- **Passed**: the tenant meets the check.
- **Failed**: it doesn't. Fix it with the standard under Fix with CIPP, or by hand, using the steps CIPP shows for the test.
- **Investigate**: CIPP found something a person should review. Read the result in CIPP.
- **Informational**: reported for context, with no pass or fail.
- **Skipped**: the test didn't run, often because the tenant lacks the license or feature it needs. Read the result in CIPP.

Each entry shows the risk, the effort to fix and the impact on users, as CIPP rates them.

**Fix with CIPP** lists the CIPP standards linked to the check. CIPP's links are sometimes wrong. Where QIT has checked a link and found it wrong, the entry names the right fix and says why. After changing anything, confirm the result on the next test refresh.

Build the QIT M365 Best standards template in your own CIPP from the standards and conditional access policies named in this runbook. It can't ship in this repo, because ConditionalAccessTemplate references a template GUID unique to each CIPP instance. Risk-based policies need Microsoft Entra ID P2 for every user they cover.

## Identity and access (11 checks)

### ZTNA21786 — User sign-in activity uses token protection

Risk: High · Effort: Low · User impact: Low

**Fix with CIPP:** a conditional access policy (`ConditionalAccessTemplate`). Configure in your QIT M365 Best template.

**Links:** [Microsoft Learn: concept token protection](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/conditional-access/concept-token-protection)

**Full description and manual steps:** in CIPP, Dashboard > QIT M365 Best > ZTNA21786. Without the QIT suites, use CIPP's built-in ZTNA suite.

### ZTNA21813 — High Global Administrator to privileged user ratio

Risk: High · Effort: Medium · User impact: Low

**Fix with CIPP:** no standard at this level fixes it.

**QIT note:** CIPP's link corrected: The check fails when Global Administrators make up 30% or more of privileged role holders; session timeout doesn't affect it. Move admins to narrower roles in Entra admin center > Roles and admins.

**Links:** [Microsoft Learn: best practices (5 limit the number of global administrators to less than 5)](https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity/role-based-access-control/best-practices#5-limit-the-number-of-global-administrators-to-less-than-5)

**Full description and manual steps:** in CIPP, Dashboard > QIT M365 Best > ZTNA21813. Without the QIT suites, use CIPP's built-in ZTNA suite.

### CIS_1_3_2 — 'Idle session timeout' is set to '3 hours or less' for unmanaged devices

Risk: Medium · Effort: Medium · User impact: Medium

**Fix with CIPP:** a conditional access policy (`ConditionalAccessTemplate`). Configure in your QIT M365 Best template.

**QIT note:** CIPP's link corrected: CIPP's check reads conditional access for a sign-in frequency of 3 hours or less, not the web idle-timeout policy that ActivityBasedTimeout sets. Add a conditional access policy with that frequency for unmanaged devices.

**Reference:** CIS Microsoft 365 Foundations v7.0.0, 1.3.2

**Links:** [CIS: microsoft 365](https://www.cisecurity.org/benchmark/microsoft_365) · [Microsoft Learn: concept session lifetime](https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity/conditional-access/concept-session-lifetime)

**Full description and manual steps:** in CIPP, Dashboard > QIT M365 Best > CIS_1_3_2. Without the QIT suites, use CIPP's built-in CIS suite.
